title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
summary: US fusion company using high-temperature superconducting magnets.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Commonwealth Fusion Systems is building the SPARC tokamak to demonstrate net energy gain using high-temperature superconducting magnets, with a planned ARC power plant. It has raised large private rounds and partners with MIT. Magnet performance and plasma physics are the key risks.

Technology Exposure

  • Tokamak fusion development
  • High-temperature superconducting magnets
  • Power-plant design

What To Watch

  • SPARC net-energy demonstration
  • ARC financing
  • Magnet manufacturing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
